mapper.select: SELECT id FROM bike_sys_user WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,username,display_name,user_type,agent_id,workstation_id,enabled,must_change_password,last_login_at,created_at,updated_at FROM bike_sys_user WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_sys_user WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
SELECT role_id FROM bike_sys_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY role_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_agent WHERE id=#{agentId} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_workstation WHERE id=#{workstationId} AND enabled=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_sys_role WHERE enabled=1 AND id IN #{roleId}
SELECT r.role_code FROM bike_sys_role r JOIN bike_sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.enabled=1 AND r.enabled=1

SELECT p.permission_code FROM bike_sys_permission p JOIN bike_sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.id JOIN bike_sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=rp.role_id JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id JOIN bike_sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.enabled=1 AND r.enabled=1
SELECT w.workstation_type FROM bike_workstation w JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.workstation_id=w.id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.enabled=1 AND w.enabled=1
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_sys_user SET last_login_at=NOW(3) WHERE username=#{username}
UPDATE bike_sys_user SET auth_version=auth_version+1,password_hash=#{passwordHash},must_change_password=0 WHERE username=#{username} AND enabled=1
UPDATE bike_sys_user SET auth_version=auth_version+1,password_hash=#{passwordHash},must_change_password=1 WHERE username=#{username} AND enabled=1 AND must_change_password=1
